classification_keys.SUBPROJECT: projects/image-structured-modeler visual grounding, structured graph, and PartGraph extraction

findings.title: Facade layers are additive overlays instead of clipped construction layers
findings.manual_review_signal: Lower grey decorative/plinth face can cover or interfere with corrected door area.
findings.subproject_gap: Facade layer, opening ownership, and clipping relationships are not represented in the PartGraph.
findings.mainline_gap: No high-level trim-aware facade cladding operation is used for decorative panels.
findings.next_fixture: Assert lower grey/plinth panels are interrupted around personnel and loading doors.

findings.title: Door correction changed dimensions but not surrounding facade hierarchy
findings.manual_review_signal: Doors moved/resized, but base treatment and local facade details remained inconsistent.
findings.subproject_gap: Door relations should include canopy alignment, plinth interruption, sill/base clearance, and adjacent material layer boundaries.
findings.next_fixture: PartGraph correction should update opening and related facade-layer relations together.

findings.title: Side-elevation windows are still wrong
findings.manual_review_signal: Manual review rejected the side elevation after approximate recentering and resizing.
findings.subproject_gap: Side elevation needs crop-calibrated window landmarks and a dedicated side-facade coordinate frame.
findings.next_fixture: Encode upper ribbon extent, lower window count/spacing, and orange-panel adjacency from the side-elevation crop.

findings.title: Roof skylight should be arched/curved, not rectangular
findings.manual_review_signal: Reference drawing shows an arched roof-light cap; generated model uses a rectangular roof monitor box.
findings.subproject_gap: Need semantic detection of arched_roof_light or barrel_vault_skylight.
findings.mainline_gap: Need a stable curved skylight/barrel-vault helper or standardized arc loft workflow.
findings.next_fixture: Fail rectangular roof monitor when source evidence requires curved skylight.

findings.title: Missing high-level architectural facade clipping primitive
findings.manual_review_signal: Generic wall openings do not cut separately modeled cladding/decorative layers.
findings.mainline_gap: Generic booleans exist, but a facade_panel_with_openings or clip_panel_to_openings abstraction is needed for reliable building workflows.
findings.next_fixture: Mock/queue parity test for cladding panel cut by multiple rectangular openings and boundary trims.

findings.title: Layout QA passed while visual fidelity failed
findings.manual_review_signal: Queue QA reported pass with 0 issues despite rejected windows, roof shape, and facade occlusion.
findings.qa_gap: Need reference-visual QA against front/side drawings and occlusion/depth-order checks.
findings.next_fixture: Reference QA should fail side-window mismatch, rectangular skylight, and door-plinth occlusion.

findings.title: Manual coordinate nudging does not prove structured image understanding
findings.manual_review_signal: Corrections were made by iterating generated DSL parameters from visual feedback.
findings.subproject_gap: Failed observations need source evidence, expected relations, and PartGraph fields.
findings.qa_gap: Acceptance should require fixtures that reject current wrong relationships.
findings.next_fixture: Convert this sample into a regression with expected elevation relationships and negative cases.
